index.title: Quill — A local-first knowledge vault
index.description: Quill is a local-first desktop app for knowledge management: multi-vault isolation, multi-format editing and preview, deep AI integration, a plugin system, and voice input.

hero.lede: Quill is a local-first desktop app for knowledge management. It isolates each set of data in a Vault, fits markdown, whiteboards, ER diagrams, and mind maps into one editor, and wires AI agents straight into your workflow — everything stays on your own devices.

capabilities.lede: From vault management to AI agents, from hand-drawn whiteboards to voice input — click any card for details.

vault.title: Vault multi-vault isolation
vault.desc: Open an isolated vault for each project or set of notes — data stays separate, switch anytime.

editing.title: Multi-format editing
editing.desc: Markdown, rich text, CSV, JSON, mind maps, ER diagrams, hand-drawn whiteboards, flowcharts — one editor handles them all.

viewing.title: Universal format preview
viewing.desc: Office docs, audio/video, archives, e-books, drawings — view them without leaving Quill.

ai.title: Deep AI integration
ai.desc: Connect Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI and other CLI agents; switch freely across model vendors.

pet.title: Desktop pet assistant
pet.desc: A small companion on your desktop that pushes notifications and opens a model chat in one click.

plugins.title: Plugin system
plugins.desc: Microkernel + plugin SDK architecture. Translation, schedule, Wiki, clips, project analysis ship as plugins; third-party extensions supported.

voice.title: Voice input
voice.desc: Speech-to-text with automatic polishing, pasted straight at the cursor (macOS only for now).

terminal.title: In-app terminal
terminal.desc: Open a terminal inside Quill and let Claude Code, Codex and other CLI agents edit the current document — no window switching.

vault.lede: A Vault is the smallest unit of data isolation in Quill. Different projects and knowledge domains live in their own vaults — they don't interfere, they don't share. You decide what stays together and what stays apart.

isolation.v: Each Vault is an independent data space — notes, attachments, and plugin configs all live separately. Switching vaults is like switching an entire workspace.

multi.v: Work, personal, and team projects can split into multiple vaults that coexist; switch quickly between sidebars without mixing content.

local.v: Vault data is stored on your local device — no cloud account required. You keep full control of your data.

editing.h1: One editor for every shape of thought
editing.lede: From plain text to structured data, from flowcharts to hand-drawn whiteboards, Quill gathers the common editing scenarios into one app — no more bouncing between tools.

markdown.v:
Standard markdown syntax plus a built-in container plugin family, letting documents embed richer structures directly:
  • Button / Callout / Card / Collapsible
  • FilePreview / Grid / StatusTag / Steps / Tabs / Timeline
  • Graphviz / Mermaid / PlantUml diagram containers

richtext.v: WYSIWYG rich text editing, for cases where markdown syntax isn't needed and you just want to lay content out.

structured.v: CSV and JSON can be opened and edited inside Quill — no external spreadsheet or code tool required.

mindmap.v: markmap writes mind maps in markdown syntax; write the outline and the visual structure generates itself.

modeling.v:
• dbml — write ER diagrams for database modeling
  • drawio — architecture and flowchart drawing
  • excalidraw — hand-drawn-style whiteboard
  • graphviz — describe graphs with DOT
  • plantuml / mermaid — text-driven diagram drawing

viewing.h1: Read every file without switching apps
viewing.lede: A vault inevitably holds many formats. Quill has built-in preview so you can open them without jumping out of the app or installing extra software.

office.v: View Word, Excel, PPT and other common office documents directly in Quill — no external office suite needed.

media.v: Play audio and video files inline; ideal for organizing meeting recordings, tutorial clips, and other multimedia.

archive.v: Inspect the file structure and contents of an archive without unpacking it.

ebook.v: Read e-book formats with built-in preview — keep your library and your reading in one place.

design.v: Open presentation decks and design drawings directly — fewer round-trip exports and conversions.

ai.h1: Wire AI agents into your notes
ai.lede: Quill doesn't lock you to one model vendor. It adapts mainstream CLI agents straight into the editor — call them for analysis, generation, or refactoring while you write and organize knowledge.

cli.v: Built-in adapter support for the following CLI agents, callable directly from Quill: Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, Opencode, Pi Code Agent, Qoder.

vendors.v: Supports several model vendors — switch by task or personal preference, no vendor lock-in.

pet.h1: Always on desktop, ready to chat
pet.lede: The desktop pet is a small companion that lives on your desktop. It pushes important reminders into view and is the fastest way into a model chat.

notify.v: Schedule reminders, task changes and similar alerts pop up via the pet — no need to open the main app to check.

chat.v: Click the pet to open a model chat window instantly; ask the AI anything without breaking your workflow.

plugins.h1: Grow the features you need, on a microkernel
plugins.lede: Quill keeps its core lean; most functionality ships as plugins. Built-in plugins cover common scenarios, and third-party plugins extend on demand.

arch.v: Microkernel + plugin SDK; the core stays lightweight, features load on demand via plugins, and third-party developers can extend.

translate.v: Built-in translation plugin helps process multilingual content.

schedule.v:
• Schedule and task setup with reminders
  • Focus pomodoro timer
  • Task board

wiki.v: Organize and link knowledge entries wiki-style, building a network you can jump between.

clips.v: Capture web content and auto-summarize it into a digest page for quick save and review.

project.v: Analyze GitHub projects and emit an HTML analysis report.

voice.lede: Voice input turns speech into cleaned-up text on the spot, skipping the typing step — ideal for capturing ideas and dictating content quickly.

stt.v: Speech is transcribed in real time and pasted at the cursor automatically — no manual copy/paste.

polish.v: Transcribed text is polished to remove spoken filler, repetition, and pauses, getting closer to written prose.

platform.v: Currently macOS only; Windows is not yet supported.

terminal.h1: The terminal sits next to the editor — AI reads and writes your text directly
terminal.lede: The in-app terminal brings CLI agents into the Quill workspace. Claude Code and Codex CLI can edit the current document in place — no copy/paste, no window switching.

panel.v: Open a terminal panel inside the Quill workspace, side by side with the editor. File paths sync automatically — no need to cd into the working directory.

aitext.v: Agents like Claude Code and Codex CLI read and write the current document from the terminal; AI edits appear in the editor instantly — no manual copy/paste.

workflow.v: The terminal shares context with the editor and AI panel. Command output can be pasted back at the cursor, turning edit–invoke–paste into a single pipeline.
